content.short: Positive Web3 is a security research team offering audits, consulting, training, and Web3 security work.
content.description: Positive Web3 is a Web3 security research and audit provider. Its site describes security services for Web3 projects, including audits, consulting, training, and research from the Positive Technologies security ecosystem. It belongs in the security category because the product is expert review and risk reduction, not a consumer dapp. In our audits we use formal verification and fuzzing methods for deep and comprehensive analysis of code security. Those details make positive web3 and web3 security research part of the product story.
